positions.clause: The claim token name is blake2b-256 of the PlutusData CBOR of the EnvV2 datum, computed by a minimal encoder grounded in stdlib cbor.ak serialise examples/decoder and uplc convert_constr_to_tag, cross-checked against pallas-primitives plutus_data.rs (Constr tag+fields; BoundedBytes definite <=64 bytes, indefinite 64-byte chunks above), verified against a field-by-field frozen positive preimage; byte strings over 64 bytes (chunked 0x5f serialise_data path) fail closed and are unreachable for the frozen envelopes (all byte fields <=32 bytes).
positions.rationale: claim.ak:24-26, cbor.ak per R1 coverage, runtime convert_constr_to_tag per R1 coverage, plutus_data.rs:348-371/423-443. VK (488B) and statement (721B) never enter the hashed datum; they travel as Data B terms in the redeemer, so no chunked encoding is silently used. No material discrepancy with Pallas was found, so R1 encoder behavior is preserved.

positions.rationale: Mirrors the adopted K9 coherent-tamper construction while translating its Bool expectations to the eval.rs success/error contract (single JSON on exit 0; exit 1 with stderr on error), with the typed parser of EXECUTION-PROPOSAL.json R2.
